top_strength: Amy expertly gathered rich detail about the move (storage unit location, multiple furniture concerns, special handling needs, parking logistics) through natural follow-up questions and probing, and successfully booked the customer despite initial uncertainty about the move date.
coaching_note: Amy never asked the two-concerns question ('movers not showing up on time, or damage to their items') that is the primary opener for step 2—she moved straight into logistics probing, and while she captured concerns organically, the card's designed sequence was skipped; additionally, she delivered only one of the two promises (No Worries Damage Coverage near the end) and never delivered or mentioned the On-Time Guarantee at all, so the permission lead-in and both promises were not fully completed.
